calls.reason: CDC figures show cancer deaths remain high. But the SHIELD-RT and MASAI trials show modest AI-linked benefits, and nothing in the packet measures AI's effect on the population, so the evidence is mixed.
The packet documents no AI-discovered drug that worked in animals and then failed on human safety. BEN-2293 and rentosertib were reported safe, but two candidates cannot rule out failures elsewhere.
This says what beating cancer will require and has no deadline. Cancer has not been beaten, and CDC mortality data cannot test whether the named changes are necessary.
